en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Asram Bin Haweysh, from Isa Bin Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The valley of the Harram flows into the unrestricted area, and the valley of the unrestricted area does not flow into the Harram’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Asram ibn Hawshab from ‘Isa ibn ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “Ja’far ibn Muhammad, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘
The valleys of al-Haram (the sacred area) flow into non-sacred valleys but non-sacred valleys do not flow into al-Haram (the sacred area).’”
